issues.on_page: Supplies and Other column 11,102,920 (includes employee benefits 1,823,916 per p3 and purchased services/professional fees)
issues.issue: The Supplies and Other column mixes supplies, purchased services and about 1.82M of employee benefits (p3 benefits 1,823,916 + supplies and other 8,759,878 + depreciation 519,126 = 11,102,920). Tagging every department's line as supplies and materials overstates that object. The extractor says so in notes, but the lines carry no review flag.

The line mixes grants and contributions. Hospital noncapital grants are often government money (federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid). This is a category guess and is already marked for review.
